_comment: Rooms as enemies. Lifted out of design/spire-ai/ui/demo/demo.js, which held them inline and was convicted for it by ENTITY_STANDARDS.md rule 8. Every entry needs a checkable acceptance; a room whose clear condition is a human judgement call is an event, not a fight. Intents carry an explicit `sensor` naming the deterministic check that produces them — an intent with no sensor is a guess dressed as a telegraph, which sts-fidelity.md refuses. `clear_at` is a per-room progress target, deliberately not `max_hp`: nothing here is a health bar.

intent_kinds._comment: The Slay the Spire 2 intent vocabulary, ported. `tier` scales the attack glyph 1-5 the way StS2 scales dagger through scythe. Attack shows an exact count because partial information tested worse than either extreme — see sts-fidelity.md Part 3.

monster.name: Nit Cluster
monster.blurb: Clear by fixing the nits mechanically and separating the real note.

intents.text: Will bury the real review comment under twelve style nits.

monster.turn_effect: Three more nits arrive on the same file.

monster.name: Regression Bug
monster.blurb: Clear by pinning it with a failing test, then fixing the cause.

intents.text: Will reappear next release if you patch the symptom.

monster.turn_effect: The bug reproduces on a second code path.

monster.name: Missing Test
monster.blurb: Clear by covering the untested branch.

intents.text: Will let the next change break silently.

monster.name: Dependency Bump
monster.blurb: Clear by pinning the version and recording why.

intents.text: Will break the build in a transitive package you do not own.
Shuffles a lockfile churn card into the next room.

monster.turn_effect: A peer dependency warning turns into an error.

monster.name: Stale Doc
monster.blurb: Clear by making the written steps match the shipped behaviour.

intents.text: Will cost the next reader an hour rediscovering what changed.

monster.turn_effect: Someone follows the old steps and files a bug.

monster.name: Widening Interface
monster.blurb: Clear by narrowing the signature and migrating the callers.

intents.text: Will grow a fourth optional argument before the week is out.

monster.turn_effect: A new caller passes the flag positionally.

monster.name: Unowned TODO
monster.blurb: Clear by naming the owner or deleting the note.
monster.turn_effect: Two more TODOs appear beside it.

monster.name: Slow Endpoint
monster.blurb: Clear by measuring first, then removing the one hot call.

intents.text: No profiler has run here yet.

monster.turn_effect: A second caller starts hitting the same path.

monster.name: Config Drift
monster.blurb: Clear by making the environments describe themselves in one place.

intents.text: Will make the next deploy behave differently than the last.

monster.turn_effect: A third environment gains its own override.

monster.name: Undefined Done
monster.blurb: Clear by writing Done as a sentence someone could check.
monster.turn_effect: A new must-have is remembered aloud.

elite.name: Flaky Suite
elite.blurb: Clear by stabilizing the suite, not by quarantining tests.

intents.text: Will fail CI randomly if ignored.
Gets harder to reproduce the longer it runs.

elite.turn_effect: A red test blinks green and hides itself.

elite.name: Duplication Hydra
elite.blurb: Clear by collapsing the copies behind one caller.

intents.text: Will grow a third copy while you edit the second.
Spawns a fourth copy in a module you have not opened.

elite.turn_effect: Someone copies the block into a new module.

elite.name: The Auth Hole
elite.blurb: Clear by closing the path and adding the regression test that proves it.

intents.text: Will stay open in production until a test names it.
Every adjacent route inherits the same gap.

elite.turn_effect: A second route is found sharing the middleware.

elite.name: Perf Cliff
elite.blurb: Clear by finding the size where it falls over and bounding it.
elite.turn_effect: Load doubles and the margin disappears.

elite.name: The Half Migration
elite.blurb: Clear by finishing the migration or rolling it back — not by living in both.

intents.text: Will strand every reader between the old shape and the new one.
Marks one card in your deck as unsafe to play here.

elite.turn_effect: A read path is found that only understands the old shape.
